in_arabic.name: زُنَيْرَة
in_arabic.meaning: زُنَيْرَة اسم بنت معناه جميلة و مشرقة الوجه
in_arabic.long_meaning: زُنَيْرَة هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي و معناه الفتاة الجميلة جدا ذات الوجه المشرق و اللون الزاهي و هي من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم

in_urdu.name: زنیریہ
in_urdu.meaning: زنیریہ کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت اور روشن چہرہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: زنیریہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت اور مشرقی چہرہ۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں ایک خاص اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ زنیریہ رضی اللہ عنہا رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کی ایک صحابیہ تھیں

in_hindi.name: ज़ुनैरा
in_hindi.meaning: ज़ुनैरा का अर्थ है सुंदर और उज्ज्वल चेहरा
in_hindi.long_meaning: ज़ुनैरा एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है बहुत सुंदर और उज्ज्वल चेहरा वाली लड़की। इस्लामिक परंपरा में, ज़ुनैरा एक महत्वपूर्ण नाम है क्योंकि यह पैगंबर मुहम्मद की एक सहाबिया का नाम था

in_pashto.name: زنیری
in_pashto.meaning: زنیری د ښکلاوو او روښانه مخ معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: زنیری د عربي اصل نوم دی چې د ښکلاوو او روښانه مخ معنا لري. په اسلامي دود کې، زنیری د پېغمبر محمد صلی الله علیه وسلم د یوې صحابيې نوم دی

in_english.name: Zunairah
in_english.meaning: Beautiful and radiant face, lovely and bright
in_english.long_meaning: Zunairah is an Arabic name that means beautiful and radiant face. It is a name of great significance in Islamic tradition as it was the name of one of the companions of Prophet Muhammad. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'z-n-r' which means to shine or to radiate light

data.cultural_impact: The name Zunairah carries a deep cultural significance as it is derived from the Arabic word "Zunun" which means "a shelter, a protection or a refuge". In Islamic culture, the importance of providing safety and security is highlighted in various teachings and traditions. Zunairah, as a name, can serve as a constant reminder for parents to provide their children with a secure and loving environment. Also, it is a name that evokes a sense of comfort and safety in society and is often given to children who are born during times of turmoil or instability.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Zunairah is rooted in the concept of seeking refuge in Allah (God). In Islamic teachings, seeking refuge in Allah is a constant reminder of His infinite mercy, protection, and compassion. The name Zunairah can serve as a daily reminder for the bearer to seek Allah's shelter and refuge in times of distress and hardship. It is a name that emphasizes the importance of faith and trust in Allah and inspires the individual to turn to Him for solace and guidance. Ultimately, the name Zunairah signals a strong spiritual connection to Allah and embodies the inner trait of seeking refuge and protection in the Divine.
